name: email-excluded-mailbox-same-domain-different-local-valid
description: A mailbox-form rfc822Name excluded constraint (alice@example.com) excludes ONLY that exact mailbox per RFC 5280 4.2.1.10. A SAN at a different local part on the same domain (bob@example.com) does not match the excluded mailbox, so the chain is valid. If the issuer wanted to exclude all mailboxes at example.com they would use the host-form constraint `example.com` (no @) or the subtree-form `.example.com` (leading dot).
